title: Terms of Service
intro: These terms govern use of the ICR marketplace by buyers, vendors and professionals. Please read them together with the Privacy Policy, which explains how we handle personal data.

sections.heading: Agreement to these terms
paragraphs: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern access to and use of the ICR marketplace, operated by Vinfraa Pvt Ltd, a company incorporated in India that trades as ICR — Institute for Corporate Real Estate ("ICR", "we", "us"). By creating an account or using the platform you agree to these Terms on behalf of yourself and, where applicable, the business you represent. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
The contracting entity is Vinfraa Pvt Ltd, #42, 1st Floor, 7th Cross, 23rd Main, JP Nagar 2nd Phase, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India. You can reach us at info@icr.org.in or +91 6366937506.

sections.heading: The platform
paragraphs: ICR is a B2B marketplace that connects corporate buyers with facility-management vendors: buyers publish requirements (RFQs), vendors submit quotes, and the parties may award and manage work through the platform.
ICR is a facilitator, not a party to contracts formed between buyers and vendors. Unless expressly stated, we do not provide, supervise or guarantee the services procured through the platform.

bullets: The platform is intended for business use by users aged 18 or over acting on behalf of a legal entity or proprietorship.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you register and for safeguarding your credentials; activity under your account is attributed to you.
Roles (buyer, vendor, professional) carry different capabilities; you agree to use only the capabilities appropriate to your legitimate role.

paragraphs: Vendor verification levels reflect checks performed on documents and platform performance signals at a point in time. They are provided to assist buyer judgement, not to replace it. ICR does not warrant that a verified vendor will perform, and buyers remain responsible for their own commercial due diligence.
Vendors agree that documents submitted for verification are authentic and current, and that misrepresentation is grounds for removal from the marketplace.

bullets: Provide accurate requirements, quotes, company information and reviews; reviews must reflect genuine transactions.
No circumvention: do not use the platform to source counterparties and then move transactions off-platform to avoid platform terms that apply to them.

No unlawful content: nothing infringing, defamatory, deceptive or in violation of applicable law may be posted to the platform.

paragraphs: Quotes submitted through the platform are commercial offers by the vendor. An award recorded on the platform evidences the buyer’s selection; the resulting contract, including price, scope, SLAs and payment terms, is between buyer and vendor.

Where payment features are offered, they are provided through third-party payment processors subject to their own terms. Fees and subscription tiers, where applicable, are described on the membership page at the time of purchase.
